dialog: You seem down. Why the long face?
Oh...you're upset? Bummer.
Fortunately for me, I'm doing better than you.
My go-to solution is always resorting to alcohol. Fancy a beer?
My name is Gek, by the way. I'm the local bartender.
BARTENDER?! I HARDLY KNOW 'ER!
Oh!
Before you go...
...chicken butt.
randomDialog: My wife left me twice. She's in a wheelchair now.
Kinda sucks how alcohol poisons you. My ex wife found that out the hard way.
You know, it's really not ideal how all of my customers are "under the legal age to drink." I just think the police are trying to clear everyone out so their orders get priority.
Saw the funniest thing the other day.
A mime taught me how to make a joke. I couldn't tell you how funny it was.
My neighbours knocked on my door at 2 in the morning. They looked really angry and sounded so tired. Thankfully I was up playing my bagpipes.
Met this lad named Daniel. He came into my bar without any pants. Then he told me he was lower class and it all made sense... quite the jokester, that one.
The fog is coming.
Some people say I sound like Sans the Skeleton from the hit game UNDERTALE by Toby Fox.
My boyfriend keeps telling me that his name isn't actually [REDACTED]. I don't know if he's telling the truth or not.
I'm not technically a homosexual.
If you think about it wrong, I'm kind of built like Terry Crews.
I don't understand how people can eat eggs. The shells are just too soft.
"You haven't listened to a single word I've said, have you?" is a really strange way for my wife to start a conversation with me.
A little martini told me that there was a cave around here somewhere. Perhaps look outside?
I have short-term memory loss, which would explain why I keep repeating my voicelines. It definitely doesn't have anything to do with ShortBoiAidz refusing to give me more dialog.
The code to this game is available on the GitHub. Buy Daniel's merch.
I know a guy who knows a guy.
James, while John had had "had had", had had "had"; "had had" had had a better effect on the teacher.
Bufallo bufallo bufallo Bufallo bufallo.
I don't work here; the boss just thinks I'm a veteran.
You sound hoarse.
My wife thinks I'm at work right now.
You'll see me at the end of the tunnel.
I found my wife cheating on my boyfriend with another man.
They call me Gek.
Did you here the news? Lord Verity and the Aura Farmer just got married!

dialog: Knock knock.
"Who's there?" they say...
Well they (the borjwazee) call me Daniel. Daniel Prank.
April fools, loser. My name isn't even Daniel.
As you can see by my lack of trousers. I am of the lower-class. That means I have no money.
Many of my fellow lower-class slaves-
FRIENDS. Many of my fellow lower-class friends do not own pants. Kinda makes sense seeing as lower-class people don't wear pants.
I see that you're wearing pants, you rich bastard. You have no respect for the lower-class. Take them off, FREAK.
Anyways, ever heard of the hit game Deltarune? The one with Tenna?
TENNA?! I HARDLY KNOW 'ER!
I love Delatune because of Samuel the Skeleton and Paparizz the...other skeleton.
If you couldn't tell, I LOVE to talk. I can talk about anything. I can especially talk about the hit game Deltarune, the one with Tenna.
TENNA?! I HARDLY KNOW 'ER!
You better not be trying to skip through my dialog.
The rich folk love to do that to assert their wealth over me. Thankfully, skipping dialog is impossible in the hit blockbuster game HORSE TALE by Barhorse Development.
Wanna hear a joke?
Yes? Good.
